title: Course Payment

sections.heading: Advance Booking Fee
paragraphs: To secure a place in the course, participants are required to pay a non-refundable advance booking fee. The advance booking fee includes a 3% surcharge that covers currency conversion and bank fees.

subsections.heading: Booking confirmation letter
paragraphs: An official booking confirmation letter will be sent shortly after the successful deposit of the advance amount.

sections.heading: Course Balance Fee
paragraphs: The remaining balance of the course fee can be paid upon arrival at the school by credit card, debit card, or cash. For participants choosing to pay the balance through online banking platforms, cards, or third-party apps, please note that an additional 3% surcharge will apply. This surcharge covers transaction fees imposed by the payment provider, including foreign transaction and currency conversion charges.

sections.heading: Course Balance Fee In Cash
paragraphs: Cash is still the most widely used payment method in Bali, Indonesia, and most foreign currencies are accepted, including INR, JPY, USD, EUR, GBP, AUD, CAD, KRW, CNY, and many more.

issues: Bank details recorded for the record only – NOT to be published on the demo site. The second account is a personal account (Himanshu Joshi), not the company PT.
Postcode 8057 in the BRI bank address is a typo for 80571 (A8 in 08-issues-gaps-questions.md).

SWIFT code ‘BBBAIDJA’ is published for a Permata Bank account; BBBAIDJA is Permata’s SWIFT prefix but the listed ‘Local Code – 13’ and ‘Bank Code – 013-0284’ should be verified with the owner. ‘JL Raya An dong’ likely means ‘Jl. Raya Andong’.
Cash currencies list includes INR first – suggests India-site origin; FAQ also says cash in ‘INR or USD’. Accepting arbitrary foreign currencies in cash should be confirmed.

No deposit amount is stated on this page; /course-registration/ states $250 USD. The 3% surcharge appears twice (on the advance fee and on balance paid online/by card); Terms §5 says students bear transfer/card/conversion fees – consistent, but the wording ‘credit card… or cash’ on arrival followed by ‘cards… 3% surcharge’ is ambiguous about whether card payment on arrival incurs 3%.
PayPal.me account name ‘himalayanyogaashram’ belongs to the sister India business; Razorpay is an India payment gateway.
Razorpay/PayPal URLs come from audit 06 §3 and another page capture; the links were not followed and may be dead.
The two ‘Advance Booking Fee’ H2s on the original are image/button headings (payment links), recorded under ‘Advance Booking Fee Payment Options’.
No meta description and no H1 on the original.
